checks.name: in a browser: no explanation and no registration
bridge version 4 or later with push (state, request, token, onOpen, onReceive), frozen, and notices still to be asked
the channels «يحتاج قرارك» (high, with sound), «للانتباه» (low, silent) and «الرسائل» (default), as Android's settings show them
at its opening the phone is registered for the person: Android, the installed version, no token yet
the site says why before Android asks: «تنبيهات الهاتف», «السماح بالتنبيهات» and «ليس الآن»
checks.detail:
تنبيهات الهاتف

يرسل المركز إلى هذا الهاتف ما يحتاج قرارك، والرسائل المباشرة والإشارات إليك، وما تختار متابعته. ولا تظهر على شاشة القفل نصوص الرسائل والبريد. يمكنك تغيير ذلك من «الحساب».

السماح بالتنبيهات
ليس الآن

checks.name: «ليس الآن» puts it off: not asked again at the next opening
«السماح بالتنبيهات» brings Android's own question
once allowed, the state is granted and the phone is registered again with its remembered id
this build has no Firebase project, so the token is null and nothing is made with Google
a push while the application is in front shows nothing, and the page reads its notices again
a decision is shown in «يحتاج قرارك», with sound
a tap opens the push's page in the page that is open
a push naming another site opens the application where it was, and no page of another site
an attention notice is shown in «للانتباه», silent
a message is shown in «الرسائل»
`info` is never shown
with the application closed, a push is shown, and a tap opens the application at its page
an intent from outside naming a page, without the key or with a wrong one, opens nothing
a phone removed from «أجهزتي» signs out here at its next opening, forgets its id, and registers nothing
right after signing in, a phone removed while signed out starts over in «أجهزتي» instead of signing out again

notes: Real delivery through Firebase, to a locked phone, waits for the owner's Firebase project: this build has none, so no token was made and nothing was sent to Google.
After the check: the check package is uninstalled.
